tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Upcoming electronic music parties and festivals listed on Lineup Atlas (past dates are never returned). Filter by text (artist, venue, title), city, country, kind, genre and date range. Each result has its Lineup Atlas page (webUrl): link it when you use the result.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: One party or festival by its id or slug (from search_events): dates, venue, line-up, set times when published, practical facts quoted from the official site, ticket link and FAQ.

tools.name: search_artists
tools.description: DJs and live acts listed on Lineup Atlas, by name or genre, optionally only those playing in a city.

tools.name: get_artist_dates
tools.description: An artist by slug (from search_artists or search): short bio and every upcoming date listed on Lineup Atlas, with the page of each date.

tools.name: search_venues
tools.description: Clubs and venues listed on Lineup Atlas, by name, optionally in one city.

tools.name: get_venue_events
tools.description: A club or venue by slug (from search_venues or search): address, facts and its upcoming parties.

tools.name: get_city
tools.description: A city's page by slug (from list_cities): tonight, this weekend, upcoming parties and festivals, venues and the genres that have a page there.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Every city that has a page on Lineup Atlas, with its number of upcoming dates and its slug (for get_city).

tools.name: search
tools.description: The Lineup Atlas search box: artists, parties, festivals, venues, cities and promoters matching a text, strongest first, each with its page.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
